rows.en: Both feature advanced covered underground drainage systems connected to houses.

clarification.en: Town planning represents urban, highly organized brick-built cities, whereas the Vedic period is characterized by a predominantly rural, pastoral society with timber and reed architecture.
clarification.hi: Town planning represents urban, highly organized brick-built cities, whereas the Vedic period is characterized by a predominantly rural, pastoral society with timber and reed architecture.

relationship.en: The perpendicular intersection of streets in the grid system facilitated the layout of straight, sloping underground drains alongside the roads.
